summary: Backend-focused Software Engineer developing Java 17 and Spring Boot services at IDeaS. Built REST and gRPC APIs, upgraded a 20-module Spring Boot application, and improved MongoDB data access. Used Spring MVC in production. SQL, MySQL, JPA and Hibernate experience comes from PG-DAC and an in-progress Store REST API project.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented Spring MVC REST APIs and separate gRPC APIs for cross-product communication, with pagination, filtering, audit information, and backward-compatible Protocol Buffer contracts validated through contract-style tests.
Optimized MongoDB data access using targeted indexes, bulk reads, and batched audit retrieval; developed migration logic to transform and upsert legacy records.

Upgraded a microservice application across 20 Java modules from Spring Boot 2.6 to Spring Boot 3.5, redesigning security configuration for Spring Security 6, migrating Jakarta APIs, and upgrading five generated API-client modules.

Built Ember.js/TypeScript configuration and reporting workflows with reusable multiselect components, input validation, and conditional rendering; consolidated logic and removed redundant service calls.

Applied GitHub Copilot and iterative agent workflows across feature development, RCA, scenario design, debugging, and code review to shorten delivery cycles while retaining ownership of design decisions and validation.

experience.title: Application Developer
bullets: Developed ERP mobile application modules using MVVM, separating user interfaces from presentation and application logic.
Improved API-backed data retrieval by approximately 30% by refining retrieval logic and eliminating unnecessary processing in ERP workflows.
